system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster

Resources:
  DatabaseSubnetGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup'
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'saas-app-subnet-group-${AWS::Region}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
      SubnetIds: !GetAZs [ !Sub '${AWS::Region}' ]

  VPC:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::VPC'
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/16'

  Subnets:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.1.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [ 0, !GetAZs [ !Sub '${AWS::Region}' ] ]

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup'
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 5432
          ToPort: 5432
          CidrIp: '0.0.0.0/0'

  Cluster:
    Type: 'AWS::RDS::DBCluster'
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Sub 'saas-app-cluster-${AWS::Region}'
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineMode: serverless
      EngineVersion: '14.3'
      MasterUsername: !Sub 'saas-app-master-${AWS::Region}'
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub 'saas-app-password-${AWS::Region}'
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DatabaseSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      ScalingConfiguration:
        AutoPause: true
        MaxCapacity: 64
        MinCapacity: 4
        SecondsUntilAutoPause: 300

  Database:
    Type: 'AWS::RDS::DBInstance'
    Properties:
      DBInstanceClass: db.r6g.2xlarge
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'saas-app-instance-${AWS::Region}'
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref Cluster

Outputs:
  ClusterIdentifier:
    Value: !Ref Cluster
    Description: The identifier of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster
  DatabaseInstanceIdentifier:
    Value: !Ref Database
    Description: The identifier of the Aurora PostgreSQL database instance
